*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --bg:#000;--bg-2:#030305;--bg-3:#060610;
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.038);--border:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--border-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --text:#F5F2FF;--muted:#9490B0;--soft:#CCC8E2;
  --cyan:#40CFFF;--violet:#7B5CFF;--pink:#F040C8;--green:#25D366;
  --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#38D0FF 0%,#8040E0 40%,#F030C8 75%,#FF6830 100%);
  --grad-soft:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.09),rgba(123,92,255,.11),rgba(240,64,200,.08));
  --r-xl:24px;--r-lg:18px;--r-md:12px;--r-pill:999px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);--nav-h:60px;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 8% 12%,rgba(64,207,255,.10) 0%,transparent 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 38% at 90% 10%,rgba(240,64,200,.09) 0%,transparent 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 55% 92%,rgba(123,92,255,.13) 0%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg-2) 55%,var(--bg-3) 100%);min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
@keyframes pulseGlow{0%,100%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.96)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.04)}}

/* ══ NAVBAR (from home) ══ */
.navbar{position:sticky;top:0;width:100%;height:var(--nav-h);z-index:9999;background:rgba(4,4,12,.98);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.navbar-inner{height:100%;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.nv-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0;min-width:0}
.nv-logo-img{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;display:block;background:transparent}
.nv-logo-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;line-height:1;min-width:0}
.nv-logo-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap}
.nv-logo-name b{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.nv-logo-sub{font-size:.54rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.50);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap}
.nv-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex:1;justify-content:center}
.nv-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .18s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.nv-links a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.nv-links a.active{color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(64,207,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.20)}
.nv-links svg{width:12px;height:12px;opacity:.55;flex-shrink:0}
.nv-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}
.nv-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:7px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s ease;white-space:nowrap;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.nv-btn-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.14);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.28);color:#4ade80}
.nv-btn-wa:hover{background:rgba(37,211,102,.22);color:#86efac}
.nv-btn-order{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(128,64,224,.32)}
.nv-btn-order:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.nv-ham{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;min-width:36px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);flex-shrink:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease}
.nv-ham:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.nv-ham-icon{width:16px;height:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}
.nv-ham-line{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#fff;transition:all .25s ease;transform-origin:center}
.nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(5px) rotate(45deg)}
.nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(2){opacity:0;transform:scaleX(0)}
.nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg)}
.nv-drawer{position:fixed;top:var(--nav-h);left:0;right:0;background:rgba(4,6,18,.99);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);padding:12px 14px 16px;z-index:9998;transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),opacity .22s ease;max-height:calc(100dvh - var(--nav-h));overflow-y:auto}
.nv-drawer.open{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.nv-drawer-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:12px}
.nv-drawer-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.80);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .16s ease;border:1px solid transparent}
.nv-drawer-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.nv-drawer-link.active{color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.15)}
.nv-drawer-link svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.70}
.nv-drawer-div{height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin:8px 0}
.nv-drawer-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.nv-drawer-btn{height:46px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.90rem;font-weight:700;transition:all .2s ease;text-decoration:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.nv-drawer-btn-wa{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#25D366,#128C7E);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(37,211,102,.25)}
.nv-drawer-btn-order{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(123,92,255,.28)}
@media(max-width:960px){.nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none!important}.nv-ham{display:flex!important}}
@media(max-width:380px){.nv-logo-sub{display:none}.nv-logo-name{font-size:.82rem}.nv-btn-order{padding:0 10px;font-size:.72rem}.navbar-inner{padding:0 12px;gap:6px}}

/* ══ PAGE HERO ══ */
.rs-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:72px 5% 80px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.rs-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:38px 38px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.55),transparent 100%)}
.rs-hero-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:900px;height:520px;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(64,207,255,.14),rgba(123,92,255,.12) 40%,rgba(240,64,200,.08) 70%,transparent);filter:blur(40px)}
.rs-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.20);color:rgba(150,225,255,.90);font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.70rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:22px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .05s var(--ease) forwards}
.rs-eyebrow-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2.2s infinite}
.rs-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.5vw,5rem);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .12s var(--ease) forwards}
.rs-title .plain{color:var(--text)}
.rs-title .grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rs-sub{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.82;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;max-width:54ch;margin:0 auto 32px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .20s var(--ease) forwards}
.rs-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:36px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .26s var(--ease) forwards}
.rs-trust-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--soft)}
.rs-trust-pill i{font-size:.78rem}
.rs-hero-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .32s var(--ease) forwards}
.rs-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;height:52px;padding:0 28px;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .3s ease;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.rs-btn-primary{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(123,92,255,.28)}
.rs-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(240,64,200,.28)}
.rs-btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--soft)}
.rs-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.30);background:rgba(64,207,255,.07);color:var(--cyan)}

/* ══ SECTION WRAP ══ */
.rs-section{padding:80px 5%;position:relative}
.rs-wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto}
.section-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:40px}
.section-label-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent)}
.section-label-line.r{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.10))}
.section-label-text{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.sec-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px}
.sec-eyebrow-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2s infinite}
.sec-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,2.8rem);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.05}
.sec-title em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.sec-sub{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;max-width:54ch}

/* ══ WHY RESELL — BENEFITS GRID ══ */
.benefits-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:44px}
.benefit-card{padding:28px 24px;border-radius:var(--r-xl);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:all .30s var(--ease);position:relative;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .5s var(--ease) forwards}
.benefit-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.06s}.benefit-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.benefit-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.18s}.benefit-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.24s}.benefit-card:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.30s}.benefit-card:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.36s}
.benefit-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.benefit-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--grad-soft);opacity:0;transition:opacity .30s ease}
.benefit-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.benefit-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;z-index:1;flex-shrink:0;animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.benefit-card:nth-child(2) .benefit-icon{animation-delay:.8s}.benefit-card:nth-child(3) .benefit-icon{animation-delay:1.6s}.benefit-card:nth-child(4) .benefit-icon{animation-delay:.4s}.benefit-card:nth-child(5) .benefit-icon{animation-delay:1.2s}.benefit-card:nth-child(6) .benefit-icon{animation-delay:2s}
.benefit-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.benefit-desc{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ══ CREDIT PACKAGES ══ */
.packages-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:44px}
.pkg-card{border-radius:var(--r-xl);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:all .33s var(--ease);opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .5s var(--ease) forwards;position:relative}
.pkg-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s}.pkg-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.10s}.pkg-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.15s}.pkg-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.20s}.pkg-card:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.25s}.pkg-card:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.30s}

.badge-pop{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(240,64,200,.28)}
.badge-best{background:rgba(64,207,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.28);color:var(--cyan)}
.pkg-band{padding:26px 22px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pkg-band::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--band);opacity:.8}
.pkg-band-glow{position:absolute;top:-30%;right:-10%;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow-c),transparent 65%);filter:blur(22px);animation:pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
.pkg-credits{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1;position:relative;z-index:1;margin-bottom:3px}
.pkg-credit-label{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);position:relative;z-index:1}

.pkg-feat .bold{font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
